myUpscaler includes the separately executed FFmpeg program, version 8.1.2,
under GNU GPL version 3 or later. See FFmpeg-COPYING.txt for the license.

Binary producer: Shaka Project static-ffmpeg-binaries
Upstream release:
https://github.com/shaka-project/static-ffmpeg-binaries/releases/tag/n8.1.2-1

The macOS executable uses the upstream ffmpeg-osx-arm64 asset and is signed
during app packaging. It requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15.0 or newer.
Upstream binary SHA-256 before signing:
e7b9fcd97f95f333512d6e8b8ac24d9dbc08f189f36047695499bd7b57214b22.

The exact corresponding-source inputs, build scripts, and checksums are
documented in:
https://github.com/marshiyar/mpvfx/blob/fd4367d52408d772c1ff10f83015a6b2c9c91662/studio/legal/NOTICES/FFMPEG_SOURCE.md

Public binary releases of myUpscaler must provide the matching FFmpeg
corresponding source alongside the release. The matching archive is
ffmpeg-corresponding-source-n8.1.2-1.tar.gz, SHA-256:
ba106c32a04effc26c7b585da63c503bf67cbd2a40a7a1b3e0d076693a12add9.
